The '''"Slingshot" ejection seat''' was a type of [[Ejector seat/Legends|ejector seat]] manufactured by [[Loan-chat]]. They were installed aboard [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] produced by [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom]]/[[Sublight Products Corporation|Subpro]].<ref name="SWS" />
